subject: Unit economics deep dive — follow-up and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ibarra <jordan.ibarra@fintechx.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Unit economics deep dive — follow-up and next steps

Jordan — great to chat today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps below so we can align on pricing and unit economics before the exec sync.

Key notes from the call: 
- Primary workloads: conversational assistant (avg. 750 tokens/session) + summarization (avg. 120 tokens).
- Estimated active sessions: 250k sessions/month initially, scaling to ~750k over 12 months (peak planning).
- Target gross margin for feature: 60–70% after inference cost.
- Target price sensitivity: you mentioned target ~ $100–$150 per 1M tokens as acceptable for GA economics; goal is to land below $120/1M for core features.

Preliminary Redwood estimate (high-level):
- Inference cost range: $60–95 per 1M tokens depending on quantization & cache (with Dedicated/Reserved profile and prefix caching).
- Monthly token volumes today: ~200M–300M tokens -> monthly inference cost estimate: $12k–$28.5k (range depends on model variant + batching).
- For 1M active users (example projection), incremental cost per core feature call (avg 900 tokens) ~ $0.054–$0.085 per call.

Requested next steps: 
1) Please confirm your expected monthly token volume band today and target at 6/12 months (choose one band: 0–100M, 100–300M, 300–1B, 1B+).
2) Confirm desired target $/1M tokens (you referenced $100–$150). If we aim for $120/1M, we can model pricing and margin implications.
3) I attached a simple estimate workbook — please review the assumptions tab and share any adjustments.

If that looks right I can run a focused unit-econ model (CAC payback, $/feature, contribution margin) and share before your exec sync next Tuesday.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Ibarra <jordan.ibarra@fintechx.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unit economics deep dive — follow-up and next steps

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A few clarifications and numbers from our side to help with modeling:

1) Volume bands: today we are ~220M tokens/month (conversational + summarization combined). Target in 6 months: 600M/mo, 12 months: 1.1B/mo (we expect a big expansion after integration with our premium tier).

2) Budget range: Corporate budget around $25k–$45k/month for inference initially (we have room to expand if the unit economics work).

3) Target $/1M tokens: Our leadership prefers a conservative target of $120/1M tokens for planning. If you can show <$100/1M in realistic configs that would be ideal.

4) Product metrics we care about for the model: latency p95 < 300ms for chat, availability SLA 99.9%, and deterministic pricing for forecasting.

Also — on CAC/payback: our Finance team models a blended CAC of $120 per new paid user; we target < 8 months payback for new product features. Please include that in the unit-econ model.

Appreciate the workbook — I'll review and flag edits.

Jordan
Head of Product, FintechX
jordan.ibarra@fintechx.com

Jordan — perfect, thanks for the quick reply and the bands. Quick confirmation of next steps and what I'll deliver by Monday: 

- I'll take your volume bands (220M -> 600M -> 1.1B) and the $120/1M target and run 3 scenarios: Conservative (no caching, baseline model), Optimized (quantized model + prefix caching), Dedicated Reserved (best price / committed capacity).
- Deliverables: 1) Unit-econ workbook with per-feature $/call and $/active-user-month estimates, 2) CAC payback table (with your $120 CAC assumption), 3) Margin targets and sensitivity (showing required price per seat/feature to hit 60/70% margins), 4) Recommended Redwood config (model variant + batching + caching) and expected $/1M tokens.
- I'll also include a short one-pager you can share with Finance that maps token bands -> monthly cost and necessary price per feature to hit payback targets.

Action items for you: please confirm the spreadsheet assumptions (I flagged session length / tokens per call) and share any additional constraints (e.g., max latency targets per route).

I'll send the workbook and one-pager by Monday EOD PST so you have it for the exec sync. If we need a quick follow-up call to walk through the workbook I can block 30 minutes on Tue morning.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into a model you can use.

Best,
Marissa
